a: HLS splits video into segments with a playlist for adaptive bitrate.
DASH is an adaptive streaming standard similar in idea to HLS.
Transcoding converts video to multiple bitrates/resolutions/codecs.
FFmpeg is the Swiss-army tool for media convert, cut, and probe.
Keyframe interval affects seekability and segment boundaries.
Bitrate controls quality vs file size; ABR switches ladders by network.
RTMP is commonly used to ingest live streams to a media server.
Video CDNs cache segments near viewers for scale.
DRM systems protect premium content with encrypted playback licenses.
Sprite sheets enable hover previews on seek bars.
